title: Mixed Event — Let's Enjoy Together! SpoJoy Park — Episode2 Let's Build Our Stamina!

meta.Event Outline: Kanade's fatigue has been catching up to her as of late. Worried that it might affect her compositions, she decides to put effort into building her stamina alongside Ena. They hear that a new sports facility called SpoJoy Park just opened near the station...

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Humhumhuum♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I accomplished my goal of running 3 km yesterday, so I've gotta keep it up and keep training!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But Haruka does two 5-km runs every day in the morning and evening... I really hope that I can run like her someday!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Don't stress too much, Minori.
After all, you can't become an idol in a day.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yes, Haruka!
I'm gonna take it slow and go at my own pace!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, is it okay for me to go so slow...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Minori, were you just talking to yourself?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Good morning, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, Shiho, Kohane!
Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The thing is, MORE MORE JUMP! is scheduled to do a solo show, so I've been trying to increase my stamina!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Really? A solo show? That's pretty amazing. Shizuku hasn't said anything about that...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm sure she would've told you when things were more or less set in stone. Oh, she may've been waiting to surprise you too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh no! Does this mean to ruin her surprise! Wh-What should I do...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I know!
Shiho, would it possible for you to act like you didn't hear any of this...?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I really don't think that's going to be necessary.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Still, Minori, I can't wait to see all of you perform.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll let you know once we have a date set. Until then, stay tuned!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, of course!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shizuku's probably not going to leave me alone if she sees me, but it is your very first solo show as a group...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yay! Thanks!
If you're all gonna come see us, then I need to keep trying more and more!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: For now, I'll work on getting myself to be able to run 3 km every morning and evening!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Every morning and evening...?
Twice a day?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! Haruka said she does it every day, so I also decided to start running the other day!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I was only just able to run 3 km yesterday evening...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, that's still really impressive!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I mean, just running 1 km sounds tough since you're just starting out.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So why not just take it one step at a time? I feel like endurance training is more about making it a routine as opposed to pushing yourself really hard.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks!
I'll try to take it slow and not push myself too hard!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Still... Having more stamina...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I get really exhausted while singing sometimes, so maybe I should start exercising too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Saki mentioned something about a new indoor sports facility opening up by the station.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She said it's called “SpoJoy Park”, I think?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, I heard about that too...!
It's the place where you can play soccer and tennis and ride around on rollerblades, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! That sounds super fun...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (SpoJoy Park...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (It could also be fun to do a stream there. I'll bring it up as an idea for a segment the next time we meet...)
Weekend
Minori's Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: One, two, three, four...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, I'm all stretched and ready to go! I'm gonna do my best during my jog today!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But what's my route gonna be?
I could go by the park and the station... Wait, I almost forgot!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ichika said she'd be doing a street performance down by the station today! I should stop by once I'm done jogging!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait!
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Kanade, are you okay...?
Wanna take a quick break?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I-I'm okay...
We just got started...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Are you sure? Don't push yourself too hard, okay?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I thought walking would be better than jogging since I'm with Kanade, but is this still too much for her...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(And it's really hot out today...
Mizuki egged us on to do this, but maybe it wasn't such a good idea.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But I think I have gained a little weight, so I really should exercise...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Let's walk in the shade to make sure we don't get sunburnt.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And this is your first day, Kanade, so you should take it easy...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... But I need to build my stamina...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Maybe I'll keep walking a little more since you're so motivated, Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Look, this way has more shade.
It should be a bit cooler, so wanna go together?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
O-Okay...
Thank you, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Phew...
We're finally at the center of the park.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, there's a lake over on the other side. The way the sunlight's being reflected off the surface is so pretty... It might be nice to try drawing a scene like this.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I honestly didn't see myself going out for a walk on such a hot day, but it's a nice change of pace.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What do you think, Kanade?
Isn't it...? Hm? Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
K-Kanade...?
She was right next to me a second ago. Where could she...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh no!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Kanade, are you alright?
Hang on. If you're not feeling well...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm okay...
I just stopped to take a break. I was surprised by a cicada that came flying towards me and I fell as a result.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
R-Really...?
But you fell, right? Are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, I feel fine.
Still... My legs are starting to get fatigued.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, we've probably walked at least a kilometer now. Considering your usual lifestyle, I think you've done really well, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So let's not overdo things today and try again when it's cooler out.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay, sure...
Ena, thank you for...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, you're done already...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Huh? Luka?
What are you doing here all of a sudden...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. This isn't something you normally do, right? It seemed interesting, so I decided to take a look♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm not sure “interesting” is the right word...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Also, we were just about to call it a day since Kanade looks pretty exhausted.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Really? That's too bad. Even after I came all this way to give you some encouragement.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Encouragement...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<I'm here to support Ena too...
But Kanade, you dread exercising, but decided to try it out as a way to help you focus on composing, yes?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <You have noble intentions, so doesn't it seem like a waste to stop here?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I see your point...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I get what you're trying to say, Luka, but I really think we should call things here for now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean, we've already walked a kilometer!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: A-Although, it probably wasn't as hard as it could've been because we took so many breaks...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hey, we get an A for effort!
This wasn't easy for me either!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Okay, but it's still unfortunate...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I'm looking forward to seeing what kind of song Kanade composes after she increases her stamina.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You say that, but what she composes won't drastically change, right?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Still, I started exercising for the sake of composing songs, so I'd like to do it right...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
W-Wait, Kanade!
I know composing is important to you, but you really shouldn't push yourself too hard! We can go for another walk whenever, can't we?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But...
Huh? Hang on. Is that...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hanasato...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Kanade, Ena, I thought it was you two! Hello!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hello.
Um, Minori... You helped Kanade out the other day, right? I really should thank you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, I didn't do anything special!
I just happened to bump into her while I was out for a jog...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But it's great to see you again, Kanade!
Were you two out for a walk together?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, so I can keep composing...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So you can keep composing...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, so... The thing is...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, you want to increase your stamina?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, we're the indoorsy types, so we thought it might be good to go out for walks every once in a while...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I think we overdid it...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Sorry, Ena.
After you agreed to do this with me and everything.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, it's okay.
I mean, it's just so hot out today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Right...
I could keep going a little more if it weren't for this heat...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: In that case, why not try SpoJoy Park by the station?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: SpoJoy Park...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, it's this sports facility that opened just the other day! You're supposed to be able to have fun while playing all sorts of different sports from common to really uncommon!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And it's indoors, so you can avoid the heat!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, I had no idea that a place like that existed...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Exercising while avoiding the heat sounds nice.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
And we can have fun while we do.
I guess, why not?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
...!
If it's alright with you two, do you want to go all together now?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I've also been trying to build up my stamina and I'd like to take a look around since I'd like to possibly do a MORE MORE JUMP! stream there.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hmm...
It'll be nice and cool inside and it does sound fun...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What do you think, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm okay with it...
That is, if it's okay with you, Hanasato.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yay! Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, before we go, there's somewhere I'd like to stop by first...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Stop by? Where?
Outside the station

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's see... It should be around here... Aha!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What's going on?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wait, that voice...
